person_note: Gone Girl has two participating base narrators, Nick and Amy, and both narrate in first person. Their chapters alternate by narrator and timeline, but not by grammatical person, so the correct label is FIRST rather than ALTERNATING. Amy's Part One diary is constitutive narrative material—even though it is deliberately deceptive—and the scholarly whole-book account confirms that Amy continues as a narrator through later parts and the final chapter. The numerous Goodreads event passages independently expose both spouses through I/we/my; isolated dialogue, aphorisms, generic you, and bare third-person references were not allowed to vote. q02554 appears to be Amy's closing narration despite its dialogue bucket. The only remaining uncertainty concerns local attribution or clipping of a few isolated Goodreads quotes, not the book-level person.
